digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 38
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Penhallow Cloud adds a cold storage tier
items.summary: Penhallow Cloud adds a cold storage tier in all regions. Objects move to it after a set number of idle days.
items.whyItMatters: Idle data costs less to keep.

items.title: Ormsby Vector adds filtered hybrid search
items.summary: Ormsby Vector adds filtered hybrid search that combines keyword and vector scores. Filters run before scoring, so results stay fast on large collections.
items.whyItMatters: Search over large collections stays responsive.

items.title: Brindle Cache 3.1 adds shard rebalancing
items.summary: Brindle Cache 3.1 adds online shard rebalancing, so nodes can join without a pause. Rebalancing moves data in the background and can be rate limited.
items.whyItMatters: Scaling a cluster no longer needs a maintenance window.

sources.title: Penhallow Cloud adds a cold storage tier
sources.summary: Penhallow Cloud adds a cold storage tier in the Frankfurt and Ohio regions. Objects move to it after a set number of idle days. More regions are planned.

sources.title: Ormsby Vector adds filtered hybrid search
sources.summary: Ormsby Vector adds filtered hybrid search that combines keyword and vector scores. Filters run before scoring, so results stay fast on large collections. Result pages can be fetched with a stable cursor.

sources.title: Brindle Cache 3.1 adds shard rebalancing
sources.summary: Brindle Cache 3.1 adds online shard rebalancing, so nodes can join without a pause. Rebalancing moves data in the background and can be rate limited. A new dashboard panel shows how far each move has progressed.
